text:
alex.g: Heads up — seeing a sharp rise in 502/504s for hosted inference across a handful of customers since this morning's canary rollout.
deploy_bot: deploy started by @kevin.p 1755012300 - config: affinity_v2=true
alex.g: Rolling window shows 5xx rate jump ~08:12 UTC, correlated with canary slice 10%.
sre_maya: Can you paste the top request IDs or example trace ids? And which route/model?
support_jon: Several support tickets arrived — customers A, B reporting timeouts and billing retries. They've attached request ids: r-9a7c, r-9a80, r-9b01. Latency > 3s then 504.
kevin.p: Canary enabled `route_affinity` + session TTL 300s on new infra. Old infra uses 120s. I assumed sticky sessions would be forward compatible.
maria: @kevin.p noticed some 502s right after the flag flip, thought it was transient.
sre_maya: Hypothesis: mismatch in session TTL/affinity metadata causes requests to be pinned to nodes that don't have the warm KV cache for the model -> backend timeouts when cache miss forces cold load.
alex.g: Repro steps from support: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"foo"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -i` then repeated 20x from same client -> 1 in 5 timeouts.
kevin.p: I can reproduce locally using the above with `affinity_v2` on. Repro shows initial OK then a pattern of requests routed to detached worker and timing out.
sre_maya: Can we get a targeted sample of tracer logs for the request ids? `traces r-9a7c` -> shows 1.2s queue + 2.3s cold model load, then gateway 504.
support_jon: Customers are getting billed for retries; billing asked for a pause on invoice windows for affected accounts. I'm coordinating.
ops_bot: CPU and GPU pools show no saturation; however the canary nodes show elevated cold-start counts and higher tail latency.
alex.g: Action proposal: 1) rollback affinity flag to previous behavior for canary slice, 2) demote canary to 0% traffic, 3) collect KV/cache state dump.
kevin.p: Rolling rollback now to 0% for that feature. Will update config and push.
deploy_bot: rollback executed by @kevin.p 1755012600 - routing reverted to affinity_v1 for canary slice.
maria: After rollback we're seeing 502/504s drop to baseline within ~90s. Monitoring continues.
sre_maya: Next steps: add guard in rollout to verify TTL compatibility across infra before flip, add canary healthcheck that samples repeated same-client requests to detect affinity regressions.
support_jon: I'll open a customer-facing incident note and request billing hold for the affected invoices. Also gathering customer repro logs for postmortem.
kevin.p: Root cause tentative: affinity metadata versioning + TTL mismatch causing sticky routing to nodes without warmed KV cache; will add migration shim.
alex.g: Thanks all — please add runbook links and assign owners. cc @sre_maya to lead follow-up and @kevin.p for rollback mitigation.
sre_maya: Will do. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/affinity-rollout-checklist :thumbsup:
maria: marking incident P1, creating postmortem stub.
support_jon: customers updated, will follow up with credits where appropriate.
alex.g: Closing loop once postmortem has RCA + remediation and we have a safer canary gate.
